description: Source code for handling Exhaust Gas Oxygen (EGO) sensor readings, including support for narrow-band sensors, averaging, and sensor initialization within the rusEfi engine control firmware.

methods.name: initEgoAveraging
methods.description: Initializes averaging for narrow-band EGO sensors if configured.

methods.name: updateEgoAverage
methods.description: Updates the moving average of AFR readings using CIC filtering for narrow-band sensors.

methods.name: hasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if an AFR sensor is present, including support for CJ125 wideband sensors.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Retrieves the current AFR value from the sensor, supporting narrow-band and wide-band sensors.

methods.name: initEgoSensor
methods.description: Initializes the sensor parameters based on the sensor type.

methods.name: setEgoSensor
methods.description: Sets the sensor type and initializes the sensor accordingly.
